findings: Suspension, starch granules and later clumps are different levels of description and are not interchanged.
Stirring distributes, gradual heating changes conditions, swelling changes grain size and thickening changes flow. The text does not attribute everything to evaporation.
Hot and cooled samples are compared under recorded conditions; no universal recipe for every starch is claimed.
Unused sediment, opaque, separate, settle and transparent were checked across all slots and against required word forms.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: not yet cooked限定raw生的。cooled表示曾温热后冷却，不等于未煮；opaque和transparent表光学性质，uniform均一都不说明未烹调状态。
lumps dry material trapped inside定义clumps团块。granules是原有小颗粒，不是加热后干芯团，sediment为沉积层、suspension为整体分散体系，均非所述结块。
solid particles dispersed not true solution定义suspension悬浮液。sediment指沉降物，granules单指颗粒、clumps团块不是整种混合状态；其他词无此技术名词义。
tiny starch grains仍存在定义granules颗粒。clumps为大结块而非原始微小粒，sediment是沉积集合，suspension为体系非单个小粒；其他候选不合。
Moving a spoon through it明说stirred搅拌。cooled是降温非勺子分散，separate原形不作was后被动，settle沉下与分布目的不同；其他词不表该动作。
by stages rather sudden定义gradually逐渐。其他候选没有修饰increased的渐进方式副词；uniform是形容词，不可代替gradually表升热过程。
took water increased size要求swollen膨胀的。opaque不透明、transparent透明、uniform均匀不说明粒子吸水变大；cooled表示温降而非尺寸。
less able flow freely说明thickened变稠。settle为沉降、separate为分离，均非变稠，且给定原形不能填此过去叙述槽；其他词不作这里表示酱汁变稠的过去时谓语。
to lower temperature定义cooled冷却。stirred只搅、swollen膨胀、raw生的均不说明样品后来温度降低，其他候选词形或义不合。
evenly distributed rather watery/lumps说明uniform均一。opaque与transparent是可透光程度，不表每勺组成一致，raw生的不是分布；其他词不作此均匀性质形容词。

findings: Reservoir names the reserve supply; absorbency, immersion and saturation are separate material/location states.
The passage gives a limited explanation of capillary transfer and explicitly includes evaporation and gravity; it does not promise endless automatic watering.
Pot moisture is distinct from air humidity and loss from a reservoir is not assigned entirely to the plant.
Unused horizontal, humidity, siphon, steadily and vertical were checked in all slots; orientation terms do not substitute for continuous connection.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: reserve supply water定义reservoir储水源。humidity为空气湿度、moisture含水、gravity力不指备用水库；siphon为虹吸装置或过程，不是这里称作储水的部件角色。
take liquid small spaces not shed定义absorbent吸水的。continuous连续、horizontal水平、vertical垂直、saturated已饱水均不表示材料吸入能力。
below surface直接定义immersed浸没。saturated饱水指内部含水不等于端头位于水面下，其他候选不作remain后的该位置状态分词。
narrow spaces material-water interactions明指定capillary毛细作用。siphon为虹吸名词不是此定语capillary action，gravity重力不能解释向细隙润湿关系；其他项不合。
moving water between parts定义transfer转移。evaporates单数三人称不接could原形且是入空气，不以water作此宾语；其余候选无该原形输水动词。
pot material how much water contains定义moisture含水量。humidity为空气水汽情况而非盆土中的水，reservoir供水源、gravity力均不是盆土水含量。
water from surfaces into air定义evaporates蒸发。transfer原形需对象也不表示液入空气，其他候选非此单数主语一般现在相变动作。
available spaces filled定义saturated饱和。immersed只位置在水下，不保证所用材料空间全满；absorbent是能力非已装满状态，其他词不合。
unbroken path directly defines continuous连续。horizontal和vertical说明方向不保证不中断，absorbent吸水性也不保证全段相连；其他候选不表达无间隙连接。
pulled water downwards直接指gravity重力。capillary在此可抗或伴移动但不等于向下重力，humidity湿度、siphon虹吸不是普遍向下拉力名；其他词不合。

findings: The game is newly fictional with all relevant rules supplied; no pre-existing game knowledge is needed.
Clockwise role rotation, priority for conflicts and the ban on consecutive turns are different rules. Simultaneous hidden selection is distinct from consecutive action.
The optional random tiebreaker is labelled separately rather than silently combined with the priority rule.
Unused adjacent, exception, inspect, token and withdraw were checked against every gap; discard specifically means transfer to the used pile.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: direction clock hands直接定义clockwise顺时针。adjacent为相邻、consecutive连续不表绕桌方向，random随机与固定钟向不同，其他项非该方向副词。
claim considered before others定义priority优先权。token是标记物而非先处理资格，exception例外、remainder剩余、conflict冲突不等于排序优势。
twice immediate succession直接定义consecutive连续的。simultaneous同时与先后连着不同，adjacent空间相邻，random随机均不等于两个紧接回合。
allowed under matching-card condition定义eligible有资格。random随机、simultaneous同时、adjacent相邻不表符合参与条件；其他词义或词性不符。
shared reveal rather one after another定义simultaneous同时的。consecutive逐一紧接与同时不同，clockwise方向、random随机不说明是否同一时刻揭示。
visible everyone对应revealed揭示。withdraw原形不适合were后且撤回非展示，inspect原形不是被动；其他候选无该揭牌过去分词。
more one claimed same space导致conflict冲突。priority是解争顺序而非冲突本身，exception例外、token物件、remainder剩余不指竞争同一格的情形。
by chance directly defines random随机。clockwise固定顺序、consecutive连续、simultaneous同时都不保证机会抽选；其他候选不作该机遇性质定语。
used pile rather return hand定义discard弃牌。withdraw可撤行为但不专指把用过卡放弃牌堆，inspect检查不移动到used pile，其他项非该原形动作。
unused cards stayed later说明remainder余下部分。token单标记、priority优先、conflict争端、exception例外都不是尚未用完牌集合。

findings: Thumbnail comparison is separated from full-size sharpness inspection; no actual images are necessary because the relevant properties are described.
Cropping removes edge content, enlargement changes display scale and rejection is an editorial decision; all originals remain recorded.
Caption factual context and exposure metadata answer different questions; neither automatically decides image usefulness.
Unused frame, negative, shutter, tonal and vertical were checked against each slot and the required grammar.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: small clickable preview定义thumbnail缩略图。frame是一帧而非小预览功能，negative底片不是此数字显示，caption是文字，其他词不命名该界面元素。
order taken定义sequence序列。exposure受光信息、gesture动作、sharpness清晰度、shutter快门都不指图像先后。
edges blurred rather crisp解释sharpness锐度清晰。exposure是受光不直接等于边缘锐利，tonal为形容词、gesture动作、caption文字均非该可由大图检查的属性。
movement hand connecting action定义gesture手势动作。frame图像单元、caption说明、sequence先后、shutter快门都不指画面人物的有意动作。
remove area edge定义cropped裁剪。enlarged放大保留区域不等于移除，rejected弃选不产生新裁图，其他候选无该被动裁边义。
large display及newly visible weaknesses表enlarged放大。cropped只是裁边而非为大显示增加呈现尺度，rejected未采用与display冲突；其他词不作该过去分词。
describing event checking names context定义caption图说。sequence先后、frame影格、negative底片、gesture动作都非附图文字名词。
did not serve selection purpose说明rejected剔除。enlarged放大、cropped裁剪是可选编辑动作不等于不采用，其他候选无被动弃选义。
combined settings for admitting light定义exposure曝光信息。shutter是单个快门机构，不等于此处明确要求的整体受光设置；sharpness是边缘清晰、tonal是色调形容词，其他候选不命名这类拍摄参数。
same size not dominant screen area定义uniformly一致地。vertical为垂直、tonal为色调形容词不能作此方式副词；其余候选无同等显示方式。

findings: Deposit age, reworked fragment history and inherited old-wood age are distinct; the passage does not equate a material date with a fire or deposition automatically.
Contamination is added interfering material, decay the specified radioactive process and half-life a model-defined period.
Calibration links laboratory result to reference scale; repeatability/precision does not by itself guarantee the intended archaeological interpretation.
Unused erosion, interval, measurement, uniformly and validate were checked against all slots. No actual date or unprovided dating dataset is needed.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: layer material laid down定义deposit沉积层。erosion是侵蚀移除而非堆积层，stratigraphy是层序研究或序列而非此a layer单层，interval间隔不是沉积物。
ordered sequence layers定义stratigraphy地层序。deposit单层、calibration校准、measurement测量、interval间隔均不指层叠关系整体。
older location carried newer layer定义reworked再搬运的。inherited为材料原有年龄而非明确从旧地点搬入新层，uniformly副词不能作此过去分词，其他候选无该再沉积动作。
introduced substances interfere sample定义contamination污染。erosion侵蚀不同于回收储存添入异物，decay衰变为原物过程，calibration校准不是外质加入。
radioactive substance process specified model指decay衰变。erosion是环境移除、contamination混入、measurement观察读数均非同位素自发变化过程。
period half starting amount remain明确定义half-life半衰期。interval泛时间隔不特定剩半、precision精密度、uncertainty不确定性不表示该物理期限。
against reference record calendar scale定义calibration校准。measurement只测读不保证对照转换，validate是动词不接required后的此过程名，其他名词不表该参考标定。
repeated readings close together定义precision精密度。measurement为测量本身不指重复一致性，uncertainty是未知范围而非high后此一致特征，calibration为过程不是重复接近程度。
instead perfectly known moment表保留uncertainty不确定性。precision可重复一致但不能表达尚未知边界，half-life物理周期、interval泛时段不能替代认识状态。
old wood already aged before burning说明inherited继承的材料年龄。reworked是搬运事件不必老木燃前龄，uniformly副词、其他名词不能作an后age的该性质定语。

findings: The mechanism is explicitly a simplified model with fixed private values; the passage does not claim a universal bidding strategy for real markets.
Valuation, bid, reserve price and final payment are separate quantities. Winner names the participant, not one of the amounts.
Independent behaviour excludes collusion in the stated model. Incentive and truthful are defined without asserting every participant actually reports honestly.
Unused allocation, dominant, strategic, uncertainty and withdraw were checked in every slot. Surplus is distinguished from seller revenue.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: value assigned receiving object定义valuation估值。bid是实际报数未必同值，allocation分配、surplus价值减支付、reserve底价都不是私人价值本身。
inside envelopes hidden deadline要求sealed密封。strategic策略性不等于封存，truthful诚实不等于别人看不见，dominant占优也非信封状态，其他词不作offers were后的该分词。
number written offer定义bid出价。valuation内心价值可不同，reserve卖家门槛，surplus剩余、incentive动机都非提交的报价。
highest valid offer person allocated定义winner中标者。allocation是行为而非人，其他候选不命名最高有效报价取得物件的参与者。
minimum seller acceptable price定义reserve保留价。bid为买家报价非卖方门槛，valuation私人估值不等于最低售值；其余候选无该固定词组reserve price的义。
rather coordinating offers明确independently独立地。其他候选无表独立行为方式副词，strategic形容词不能代替这里的acted方式副词。
agreement manipulate competition定义collusion合谋。allocation分配、incentive动机、uncertainty不确定性、surplus剩余都不指参与者串通协议。
motivation created payment rule直接定义incentive激励。valuation价值、bid行动、allocation分配、uncertainty未知均不直接指规则带来的行为动机。
report value honestly直接定义truthful诚实的。strategic策略性不保证报真值，dominant占优是策略比较属性不等同诚实报告，sealed封闭不说明真伪。
value minus payment直接定义surplus剩余收益。seller revenue是收款而非买家价值差，valuation未减付、bid是报价、reserve底价都不等于该差额。

findings: Corpus collection, attested form, citation source and headword entry label are separate documentary roles.
Sense concerns meaning, register style and regional geography; none is inferred solely from one user’s identity.
Obsolete does not make old texts uninterpretable. Variant spelling remains a relation supported by examples, not an automatic new word.
Unused currency, idiomatic, speculative, transitive and verbatim were checked across all slots; missing evidence in one corpus is not universal nonexistence.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: collection language examples systematic study直接定义corpus语料库。citation单条引证、headword条目词头、usage用法不是整套研究集合；currency指通行性非材料集合。
dated text actually evidenced定义attested有文证。speculative为推测与可核文本相反，verbatim为逐字并不表示存在证据的词形，其他候选不作one后的该分词。
record words source、route back evidence定义citation引证。corpus整个集合、headword词头、variant异体、sense义项都不是带来源的单条证据记录。
entry main printed label直接定义headword词头。citation引证、sense词义、register语体、variant异形不等于条目主标。
one meaning in context直接定义sense义项。headword是词形标题，usage广泛用法、register语体层次、citation实例均非这里特定语义。
level style formal conversational定义register语域。currency通行性、regional地域属性、usage总用法不专指此风格层级；其他候选不合。
geographical variety定义regional区域性。idiomatic为惯用、transitive及物、obsolete过时、speculative推测均不表示地域关联。
no longer ordinary current use定义obsolete废弃过时。regional地区限定不等于不再用，idiomatic惯用反不说明时间退出，transitive句法属性、speculative猜测均非时态地位。
different spelling related rather unrelated说明variant异体。sense不同意义未必异拼，headword主词头不等于附列异形，citation用例不是拼写关系类别。
how people actually used expressions定义usage用法。currency只是流行通用程度，register语体、citation实例、corpus集合都不能完整代替该实际使用情况总类。

findings: Production batch and shipping consignment are expressly many-to-many; neither identifier alone is allowed to certify the affected set.
Defective is a specification judgement; recall a coordinated response; isolation applies to on-site stock and dispatch to goods sent out.
Inventory is held quantity, distribution movement through recipients, sampling an inspection design and reconciliation a check across records.
Unused consignment, expiry, sealed, upstream and yield were checked against all gaps. The case does not assert a real recall or a guarantee about untested goods.
unresolvedConcerns: Same-author lexical/grammar/global once-only review only; no independent teacher or learner calibration.

questionAudits.finding: group made recorded production conditions定义batch生产批。consignment按同次运送分的货批，文中明确一生产批可多配送且一配送可多批，不能互换；inventory库存总账非生产单元。
ability follow production later movements定义traceability可追溯性。distribution是分销动作网络、inventory持有量、yield产出量不直接等于追踪能力。
failed relevant specification定义defective有缺陷。sealed封装不等于不合规格，isolated被隔离是处置不是缺陷性质，upstream上游不评合格，其他候选不合。
organised request return affected goods定义recall召回。consignment运货、sampling抽检、distribution分销、expiry到期都不是通知回收的响应。
from usable stock to prevent sent说明isolated隔离。sealed封严未必从正常库分开，dispatched反而已寄出，与still on site待查矛盾；其他词不表该处理。
recorded quantities held定义inventory库存账。distribution移动记录不是当下所存总量，yield生产产出不等于仍持有，batch单批、consignment单货运不是全库存记录。
moved through sellers receiving organisations定义distribution分销流向。expiry到期、sampling抽样、yield产量不指下游流转记录；inventory静态持有不同。
sent away factory直接定义dispatched发运。isolated隔离未外发，sealed密封未必已寄，defective缺陷性质不说明出库；其他词词性不合。
which units examined rather easiest定义sampling抽样。recall为召回，distribution分销、inventory库存、expiry到期均不指挑哪些单元检验的设计。
checking resolving discrepancies records定义reconcile核对调和。yield为产生不以different records为此核差宾语，其他候选非to后的该原形动作。
